parts.t: The Quay is New Westminster's showpiece waterfront community — a lively district of condos, restaurants, and a beloved public market all set against the Fraser River. Residents enjoy the Riverside path, seasonal events, and one of the Lower Mainland's most scenic urban waterfronts.
